title: Question card with lettered choices
evidence: It works and looks as the oracle's 1.0.3 card (fixtures/states: oracle-ask-choice, oracle-choice-answered, a version exception, docs/decisions/0008). claude's AskUserQuestion arrives as Barkpark's approval_requested with the questions; components/Cards.tsx QuestionCard + styles/cards.css: the question in bold, a row per choice with a lettered square, 480 wide on rgb 31, radius 24; answered, only the chosen row with its square filled blue and the question dimmed. One single-choice question answers on a press; several questions or a pick-several go with Send once each has a choice (chat/api.ts answerQuestion; Barkpark checks every choice). The status says "<bot> asked: <question>" as the oracle's does. Once the bot's computer has the answer, the card stays in the conversation answered (chat/useConversation.ts; its behaviour rule fails on the old code). Live: npm run turn:live -- --question (2026-11-13: 3 choices, B pressed, the bot replied with that choice). Not in the title, still open: after a reload the answered card is not brought back (Barkpark's stored rows are not read for it); several questions, pick-several and a choice's hover are not captured on the oracle, so their look is ours; the placeholder "Type your answer, or talk about something else" is ours, as Gate A cannot read a placeholder. On 1.2.3 (decision 0010) oracle-ask-choice is 71/71 and oracle-choice-answered 68/69 (box cases 6/17). The miss: in choice-answered alone, Grok leaves 1 pt between the answered card's row and the reply's (599, then 600); four other captures have none, so ours draws none. Its rows above sit 1 lower than Grok's, and the file card cut off at the top of the window shows one more painted box (card#1 parts: box 2, not 1).
gate: Gate A oracle-ask-choice 71/71 (box cases 6/17), oracle-choice-answered 68/69 (box cases 6/17) (card cases: scripts/lib/cards.mjs); behaviour 4 rules; live parity/live/question.json
